title: Fuselage — Fwd Lower Shell Lap Joint — Installation of the External Bonded Doubler Strap

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the externally bonded and riveted strap across the forward lower shell lap joint, which lowers the bearing stress at the outer fastener row and replaces the repetitive eddy current inspection by a visual check of the strap perimeter.

sections.planning_reason: Aircraft that remain on the built-up lap joint carry a repetitive high frequency eddy current inspection every 4500 flight cycles, which requires paint removal, jacks and a specialist team. The bonded strap lowers the bearing stress at the outer fastener row far enough for the repetitive inspection to be replaced by a general visual check of the strap perimeter at each structural check. Operators of high-cycle aircraft recover the cost of the strap in about four inspection cycles.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin installs an aluminium alloy strap externally over the lap joint on each side of the aircraft, spanning stations 1080 to 1360 and overlapping the joint by four fastener pitches above and below. The strap is installed wet with a structural adhesive film and mechanically fastened through the existing pattern, oversized by one nominal diameter after removal of the original fasteners. Where an earlier splice plate is fitted it stays in place and the strap footprint steps over it.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the aircraft on jacks. Confirm that the eddy current inspection of Service Bulletin ZPH-53-1118 has been done at this visit and that the joint was found clear. Remove the paint from the strap footprint and abrade the bonding surface. Remove the fasteners along both rows and ream the holes to the first oversize. Do an eddy current inspection of every reamed hole. Apply the surface protection to all bare surfaces to the chromate-free process. Position the strap MOD50333-97 with the adhesive film and apply the bonding pressure for the full cure period. Install the rivets AES645587-2A wet, working from the centre outwards. Restore the fairing compound and the paint scheme to aerodynamic smoothness class B. Do a general visual inspection of the strap perimeter and record the embodiment. Update the aircraft inspection programme to delete the repetitive eddy current task.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-20 and ZEPHYR-22 aircraft in the MSN range Z00051 to Z03884. The aircraft must already have had the eddy current inspection of Service Bulletin ZPH-53-1118 at the same visit, and the chromate-free surface protection process must be available at the embodying site.
sections.material_note: Kit K5321-1121-02 contains the two straps, the adhesive film, the oversize fastener set and the surface protection materials for one aircraft. Lead time is sixteen weeks. The adhesive film has a twelve-month freezer life and must be ordered against a confirmed slot.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, and in any case before the third repetition of the inspection required by Service Bulletin ZPH-53-1118.

revision_history.reason: Chromate-free surface protection made mandatory following the process change; cure temperature tolerance narrowed in step 7
